name: SaltWater Restaurant
signature_dish: Coastal seafood with separate veg + non-veg kitchens
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #2 of 47 Porbandar restaurants (4.4/5) — Porbandar's main proper non-veg seafood address on the Dwarka Road just outside city limits. Runs separate veg and non-veg kitchens (rare for the region) and is the de-facto pick for travellers wanting Saurashtra coast seafood without resort markup.
insider_tip: Sits ~3 km north of Chowpatty on the way out to Dwarka — not a temple-walking-distance pick. Manicured lawn seating is the best summer evening table; book ahead for weekends when local families fill it.
signature_address: Outside Porbandar city, Dwarka Road, Bokhira, Porbandar 360575

name: Vimal Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #4-ranked Porbandar restaurant (4.6/5) — the de-facto budget thali address right opposite the police chowky outside Porbandar Railway Station. Unlimited thali listed at ₹100 with soft phulka, dal, rice and a rotating shaak; pure-veg, established 2009.
insider_tip: Best as the first lunch after the overnight train from Ahmedabad or Mumbai — 2-minute walk from the railway station, served fast for travellers on a tight bus connection.
signature_address: Near Railway Station, opposite Police Chowky, Uganda Road, Bhojeshwar, Porbandar 360575

name: Swagat Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #6 of 45 Porbandar restaurants (3.8/5, ~38 reviews) — a long-running pure-veg multi-cuisine on MG Road. Reviewers consistently call it 'very hygienic' and praise the South Indian dosa side, which most Porbandar restaurants don't bother with.
insider_tip: Opens 8.30 AM for breakfast, useful for an early start to Kirti Mandir before the 9 AM heat. Cash preferred over card.

name: National Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the very few Porbandar restaurants serving non-vegetarian food — open since 1979, sitting opposite Dreamland Cinema on MG Road with 46 years of operation. The default address for travellers wanting biryani or chicken in a Gandhi-pilgrim town that's otherwise solid-veg.
insider_tip: Parking is on the busy MG Road shoulder — go on foot if you're staying within city limits. Boneless chicken biryani is the consistently-recommended dish; skip the Chinese.
signature_address: Opposite Dreamland Cinema, MG Road, Porbandar 360575

name: Goli Vada Pav No 1
must_try: grilled cheese aloo tikki vada pav
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's current #2 of 48 Porbandar restaurants (4.3/5, ~29 reviews) — the Porbandar outlet of the national Goli Vada Pav chain. Cooked-to-order vada pavs in under 5 minutes; the cheapest convincing meal in town for kids or a Chowpatty walk snack.
insider_tip: Sits directly opposite Bhaveshwar Temple on MG Road — easy to combine with a Chowpatty Beach evening walk. Try the grilled cheese aloo tikki version, not the standard one.
signature_address: Opposite Bhaveshwar Temple, MG Road, Porbandar 360575
